notes.title: Update 2.10.2
notes.notes:
Change Log

 - Added user presence ( watch menu on your left hand ) that shows all online users and their status 
 - Fixed Pyre's Dragon slave first explosion not working correctly in Eden
 - Fix Dragon Slave not hitting heroes
 - Fix towers not hitting heroes
 - fix when players could teleport to the base tower and not be healed
 - fixed when pom pom would have double health regeneration when using link on level 20
 - Fixed when creeps would sometimes spawn and immediately walk a bit backward
 - Fixed creeps sometimes not walking correctly in line when touching css ( space station ) 
 - Fixed healer collecting all pickups with spikes after killing a hero

notes.title: Update 2.9.2
notes.notes:
New Hero F.R.E.D

2.9.2 - NEW HERO F.R.E.D
 - New Healer's achievement skin
 - Players can shoot pickup with secondary ammo as well
 - Dragon Slave won't hurt heroes if they are hidden behind some static object like a shield/wall
 - Shotgun has 50% less damage against buildings/towers
 - Chrono/Reverse time -> After returning player to the start position, the current dash will be interrupted
 - Monthly ranking is now shown instead of Qualifier ranking
 - New game version can see older compatible replays
 - Hide the game replay winning team by default and show it on click
 - Change to Time lords upgrade path 
level 6 change from +1 sec to Time Control to +5 seconds to Time Resistance duration
level 13 change from +2 sec to Time Control to +10 seconds to Time Resistance duration
level 18 change from +3 sec to Time Control to +1 sec to Time Control

notes.title: Update 2.8.17
notes.notes:
Changelog

 - Added Captains mode
 - Added unassigned players view - this is defauilt in private matches, and can be used in normal matches when the teams are already 3 vs 3 so people don't have to leave the lobby to change the team
 - Fixed when user was able to teleport outside of the map
 - Captains mode plays are automaticaly published with comment "Captains mode"
 - Captains mode is saved automatically when user leaves the app without finishing the game
 - Damage and Health pickups can be collected with S ammo only when they are not moving anymore
 - Behemoth has different secondary ammo that slightly grows in damage/size

notes.title: Update 2.8.14
notes.notes:
Changes

- Fixed when the movement config (in the hand controlls) wouldn't show correct values
- Fixed when Healer's spikes disable radius would be much bigger than the effect
- Pom Pom no longer looses healing missiles on respawn
- Pom Pom's mines now hit Commander as well
- Pom Pom's healing missiles have double the health regen and they now show correctly if a unit is affected by multiple missiles
- Fixed rage having incorrect skin unlock color 
- Fixed when Time lord shoots an ally with time resistance, the time resistance would stay forever
- Fixed when too long matches wouldn't be saved as online replay
- Fixed Third category calculation on the MVP stand ( Most damage, Most greedy, Next Best)
- Fixed when Enforcer could level up Bot swap up to 6 times, and fixed the numbers level 1/2/3 will spawn 1/2/3 creeps
- Commander's level 10 upgrade - changed from 2x dash to +50% to tower upgrade
- Changed Behemot's level 10 upgrade from 2x projectile dostance to +50% to EMP distance
- Effort to push Warriors of Titus to the App Lab ( waiting for Oculus feedback)

notes.title: Update 2.8.11
notes.notes:
- Healer/Hook skill tree changed from bonus health regenerated from hook 5%/10%/20%/100% to 50/100/200/500
 - added ammo limit
	- P 30
	P+/S+ -12
Secondary ammo cap: 
single shot users (Behemoth, commander, chrono, interceptor, etc) = 20
shotgun users (rage, enforcer) = 20
fast shot users (whiskers, pom pom, healer) = 50
multishot users (artillery, defender) = 30
 - when player dies only S+ and P+ ammunition are lost
 - Artillery by default has higher projectile range, his 10th level upgrade is now either 2x dash speed or +20 ATK
 - Increased Interceptor Marker speed
 - Fixed when player could die on host but not on his client -> invisibility/invincibility bug
 - Fixed when user could join a lobby while the lobby wouldn't be ready -> the user wouldn't be able to start the game
 - Chrono skill tree on level 10 option changed from double the projectile speed to +7 seconds to Accelerator
 - Chrono- fixed when Accelerator wouldn't speed up primary and secondary reloading of Chrono
 - Time Lord - time resistance missiles now applies also to towers and creeps (as well as upgrade level 19 -> your allies ignore effect of slow down time)
 - Commander can Reinforce the same unit maximum 3 times
 - Commander -Change 2x dash at level 10, to 1.5x dash
 - Commander changed upgrade path ( shield regeneration from 6/12/24 -> 3/6/12 per second)
 - Artillery Bounce now shows prediction for all 3 bounce targets
 - Special ability ammunition can be unequipped - if it has not been shot it will just be kept for later, if if has been shot then the ammo is lost
 - Added a kick button for the Host, whehn player is kicked he can't join this lobby for 1 minute, let me know if you think this number should be changed
 - Defender/Artillery - Hook Push previous damage 75/200/300 now 100/250/500
 - Hook pull heroes previous damage 50/125/200 -> now 50/125/250
 - Defender's turret does only 25% damage to buildings
 - Defender's turret change Attack-Life  from 30-400/42-560/54-720  to 50-400/75-700/100-1000
